Description: Expressions of interest are invited from suitably qualified Applicants interested in being considered for the provision of Fire Management Services which will deliver a comprehensive, integrated fire safety solution across the entire Contracting Entities business. Refilling, replacement, and disposal in accordance with regulatory requirements. Asset tagging and tracking to ensure compliance and traceability o Fire Hose Reels and Hydrants - Inspection, testing, and maintenance of fire hose reels and hydrant systems pressure testing. • Lot 3: Sprinkler Systems Sprinkler Systems – Service, installation, inspection, testing and maintenance of Sprinkler systems.
